Senator Rand Paul of Kentucky joins Joe Rogan for episode 2437 of the Joe Rogan Experience. Paul, an eye doctor turned libertarian-leaning senator, is known for fights over spending, surveillance, and public health. His clashes with Dr. Anthony Fauci became defining moments of the COVID years.

Section 288k of Title 2 of the United States Code covers relief of the Attorney General when Senate counsel acts. Title 2 covers Congress, and this section sits in the chapter on the Office of Senate Legal Counsel. The hosted text is the version current in twenty twenty six. It sorts roles when two offices could act in one case.

Upon receipt of written notice that Senate counsel has taken on a representational service for a named party, a shift occurs. The Attorney General is then relieved of responsibility for that service. The notice must tie to the linked section that authorizes counsel to act. The rule avoids dual control of the same legal work.
